title: Shifting Lens
summary: Rotary Club of Bombay Queen City organised an educational guidance session at The Bai M.N. Gamadia Girls High School students appearing for their Class X Board Examinations.
description: Rotary Club of Bombay Queen City organised an educational guidance session at The Bai M.N. Gamadia Girls High School students appearing for their Class X Board Examinations. The session focused on helping students manage examination stress, overcome fear, and build confidence. Students also learned effective techniques to prepare for Science and Mathematics faster and more efficiently. The initiative encouraged conceptual understanding, made learning more engaging, and promoted effective study methods without rote learning, empowering students to approach their examinations with confidence and a positive mindset.
location: Bai M.N. Gamadia Girls High School, 268, Shamaldas Gandhi Marg, Opposite Parsi Dairy Farm, Princess Street, Mumbai, Maharashtra
